newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT-NYMEX crude in range, heat chart flags top.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-NYMEX crude in range, heat chart flags top.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
* Conditions could become choppy as thin volumes allow tests of support and resistance with technical indications mostly in neutral and offering little direction to the markets.

* The NYMEX heating oil front-month continuation chart is beginning to flag a third top reversal. Two similar previous patterns have tipped the market lower and both downside gaps to these falls remain open and could be targets, chartists said.

NYMEX crude and products futures are expected to range trade on Wednesday in a period of consolidation but conditions could become choppy as thin volumes allow tests of support and resistance, analysts and brokers said.
Key technical indications remained mostly in neutral offering little direction to the markets.

July WTI made a move up on the back of the APIs and initial resistance is found at $21.80 followed by $22 and $22.20 and then just above Friday's high at $22.45, GNI Research said in its daily report.

However, IPE brokers said support from the APIs was likely to be more muted when the NYMEX market opens, with overnight ACCESS gains looking slightly overdone as much of the draw was in the PADD 5 West Coast region.
"Many players are becoming sceptical over the validity of the APIs especially with the gyrations in the gasoline stock figures we have seen over the past few weeks," one broker said.

A band of support is located between $21.44 and $21.60 a barrel. GNI was cautious today though citing a slight loss of momentum and a couple of warning signals from oscillating trend indicators. They expected no long liquidation while these supports remain intact.

The NYMEX heating oil front-month continuation chart is beginning to flag a third top reversal. Two similar previous patterns have tipped the market lower and both downside gaps to these falls remain open and could be targets, analyst said.
Crossing 10/20-day moving average lines as occurred on Monday have also signalled the fall in the previous two wave of dips, they said.
The unleaded gasoline contract ended on Tuesday with a near doji candlestick formation. This after a long white candlestick on Friday flags a market that May have topped out for the time being.
However, analysts said that though momentum indicators remain firmly in the neutral zone a break up was not out of the question, although there was still some strong resistance to be broken down.
"The break higher yesterday afternoon threatened Friday's selling extreme but in the end it held showing that resistance is still strong," Fenella Graham at MeesPierson said.
